purpose: Teach: 解い/こぼれ/海老/くれぐれも/元旦/眠気/病人/想い出

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、数学のテスト、難しい問題、自分で、解いたよ、本当に、嬉しいよ、私、リク、お前、どうだった、テスト?
lines.en: Riku, I actually solved this really hard math problem on the test myself. I'm so happy about it.
lines.style: Bright, proud energy on the opening. Quick pace, eager to share. Slight lift on 「嬉しい」 — genuine pleasure, not performing. Leans forward slightly with the accomplishment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お弁当箱、お汁、こぼれちゃってさ、ちょっと、悲しかったぜ、桜、お前は、大丈夫だったか、お弁当?
lines.en: Yeah? That's cool. My lunch box leaked though — the soup spilled everywhere. Kind of bummed about that.
lines.style: Wry deflection with warmth underneath. Casual cadence. Light self-deprecation on the spill — not actually upset, just gently playing it off. Meets her energy but keeps his own steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭で、海老フライ、出店するクラス、あるって、聞いた、リク、お前、行ってみたい?食べてみたい、私、絶対!
lines.en: Oh, I heard some class is doing a shrimp fry stand at the school festival. Do you want to go? I definitely want to try it.
lines.style: Animated, excited. Fast pace on the details. Natural enthusiasm — she's already decided they're going. Light, inclusive tone on the question, like she's inviting him into something she's already imagined.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、くれぐれも、夜更かし、しないでね、桜、明日、テストだろ、お互いに、しっかり、寝ような、絶対、約束。
lines.en: But seriously, don't stay up late tonight, okay? You've got a test tomorrow, and I do too. Let's both get proper sleep. Promise me.
lines.style: Shifts to quieter concern. Firmer tone — not bossy, but genuinely looking out for him. Slow enough to land the seriousness. The word 「約束」 lands with quiet weight.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 元旦、家族で、お祖父ちゃんち、行く予定なんだ、リク、お前も、家族と、過ごすんだろ、お互いに、よいお年を、迎えようね。
lines.en: I'm going to my grandfather's on New Year's Day with my family. You'll be spending time with your family too, right? Let's both have a good start to the year.
lines.style: Reflective, soft. Slower pace. A moment of connection — thinking about the bigger year ahead. Gentle warmth, not overly sentimental. Like she's holding space for something important between them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 授業中、眠気、こらえるの、結構、大変だよな、桜、お前、コーヒー、飲んでる?最近、私、はじめたよ、本当に。
lines.en: Staying awake in class is actually pretty tough. Have you been drinking coffee? I actually just started doing it lately.
lines.style: Wry, conversational. Natural pace. Light complaint-turned-confession. There's a small laugh underneath — they're both dealing with the same thing. Meets him on his level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、病人で、入院してて、お見舞い、行きたいの、リク、お前、付き合ってくれる?お願い、私、心配なの、本当に。
lines.en: My grandmother is in the hospital as a patient. I want to go visit her. Will you come with me? Please? I'm really worried about her.
lines.style: Vulnerable, quiet. The brightness from earlier is gone. Opens with hesitation — asking for help doesn't come easy to her. Slight tremor on 「心配」. Holds the silence after the question, like she's given him space to answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 高校生活の想い出、本当に、お前と、たくさん、作ってきたよな、桜、卒業まで、もっと、思い出、増やしたいぜ、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: You know, we've made so many memories together in high school. I want to keep making more with you until we graduate. I really do.
lines.style: Warm, sincere, close. Slower pace — each phrase landing deliberately. No performance, just honesty. Slightly breathless, like the words matter more than delivery. The final 「絶対」 is quiet conviction.
